destinations.name: Marrakech
destinations.tagline: Souks, riads and the edge of the Atlas
destinations.description: Lose yourself in the medina, sip mint tea on a rooftop and head out to the Atlas Mountains and the Agafay desert.

destinations.name: Lisbon
destinations.tagline: Hilltop views, trams and pastéis de nata
destinations.description: Seven hills, tiled facades, fado in Alfama and day trips to Sintra and the Atlantic coast.

destinations.name: Kyoto
destinations.description: Thousands of shrines, the Arashiyama bamboo grove and the geisha district of Gion.

destinations.name: Istanbul
destinations.description: Hagia Sophia, the Grand Bazaar and sunset ferries across the Bosphorus.

destinations.name: Bali
destinations.description: From Ubud's jungle to Uluwatu's cliffs, Bali mixes culture, wellness and beaches.

destinations.name: Paris
destinations.description: The Louvre, Montmartre and long lunches: Paris rewards slow wandering.

listings.title: Agafay Desert Sunset Camel Ride & Dinner
listings.excerpt: Ride camels across the stone desert at golden hour, then dine under the stars with live Gnawa music.
listings.description: Hotel pickup in Marrakech, a 45-minute drive to the Agafay desert, a one-hour camel ride at sunset and a three-course Moroccan dinner in a Berber camp with live music. Return transfer included.

reviews.author: Sara K.
reviews.title: Magical evening
reviews.content: The sunset was unreal and the guide was great with our kids. Dinner was generous.

reviews.author: Tom B.
reviews.title: Worth every dirham
reviews.content: Well organised, on-time pickup and a beautiful camp.

reviews.author: Lina M.
reviews.title: Lovely but busy
reviews.content: Beautiful setting, the camp was a bit crowded on a Saturday.

listings.title: Riad Dar Yasmine
listings.excerpt: A restored 18th-century riad with a plunge pool, roof terrace and breakfast in the courtyard.
listings.description: Eight rooms around a citrus-tree courtyard, five minutes' walk from Jemaa el-Fnaa. Breakfast, Wi-Fi and airport transfer on request.

reviews.author: Hannah P.
reviews.title: An oasis in the medina
reviews.content: Quiet, spotless and the staff could not do enough for us.

reviews.author: Youssef A.
reviews.title: Best breakfast
reviews.content: Fresh msemen every morning on the terrace. Will be back.

listings.title: Atlas Mountains & Three Valleys Day Trip
listings.excerpt: Waterfalls, Berber villages and lunch with a mountain view.
listings.description: Visit an argan cooperative, hike to the Setti Fatma waterfalls and share lunch with a Berber family.

reviews.author: Marco R.
reviews.title: Great views
reviews.content: Long day in the car but the hike made it worth it.

listings.title: Sintra & Cascais Full-Day Tour
listings.excerpt: Pena Palace, the westernmost point of Europe and the seaside town of Cascais.
listings.description: Skip the train queues: a small-group van tour to Pena Palace, Cabo da Roca and Cascais, with free time for lunch.

reviews.author: Emily W.
reviews.title: Fairytale day
reviews.content: Our guide knew every shortcut at Pena. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: David L.
reviews.title: Good value
reviews.content: A lot packed into one day, well paced.

listings.title: Alfama Fado Dinner
listings.excerpt: Traditional Portuguese dinner with live fado in Lisbon's oldest quarter.
listings.description: Three courses of Portuguese classics in a candlelit tavern while fado singers perform between courses.

reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.title: Goosebumps
reviews.content: Intimate venue and incredible voices.

listings.title: Fushimi Inari & Gion Walking Tour
listings.excerpt: Walk the thousand torii gates early, then explore Gion with a local guide.
listings.description: Start before the crowds at Fushimi Inari, then take the train to Gion for tea houses, temples and hidden lanes.

reviews.author: Ken T.
reviews.title: Perfect intro to Kyoto
reviews.content: Our guide's stories brought the city alive.

reviews.author: Anna F.
reviews.title: Beat the crowds
reviews.content: Starting at 7am was the best decision.

reviews.author: Luis G.
reviews.title: Lots of walking
reviews.content: Bring good shoes! Great tour overall.

listings.title: Ryokan Hanami
listings.excerpt: A traditional inn with tatami rooms, an onsen and kaiseki dinner.
listings.description: Twelve tatami rooms, a private hot-spring bath and a seasonal multi-course kaiseki dinner served in your room.

reviews.author: Grace H.
reviews.title: Once in a lifetime
reviews.content: The dinner alone was worth the trip.

listings.title: Bosphorus Sunset Cruise
listings.excerpt: Sail between Europe and Asia as the sun sets over the palaces and mosques.
listings.description: An evening cruise past Dolmabahçe Palace, the Rumeli Fortress and the Bosphorus Bridge with tea and snacks.

reviews.author: Omar N.
reviews.title: Beautiful views
reviews.content: Relaxed and scenic, a little crowded on the top deck.

reviews.author: Julia Z.
reviews.title: Must do
reviews.content: Best way to see the city.

listings.title: Hagia Sophia & Blue Mosque Guided Tour
listings.excerpt: Explore Istanbul's two most famous landmarks with an expert historian.
listings.description: A small-group walk through Sultanahmet covering Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque and the Hippodrome.

reviews.author: Ben C.
reviews.title: Fascinating
reviews.content: Our guide's knowledge was incredible.

listings.title: Ubud Rice Terraces & Waterfalls
listings.excerpt: Tegallalang terraces, Tegenungan waterfall and the Sacred Monkey Forest.
listings.description: A private driver takes you around Ubud's highlights at your own pace, with lunch overlooking the rice fields.

reviews.author: Chloe D.
reviews.title: Flexible and fun
reviews.content: Our driver adjusted the plan for us. Brilliant.

reviews.author: Ravi K.
reviews.title: Bali highlights
reviews.content: Saw everything we wanted in one day.

listings.title: Seminyak Beach Villa
listings.excerpt: Private pool villas a short walk from the beach and the best sunset bars.
listings.description: One- and two-bedroom villas with private pools, daily breakfast and a free scooter.

reviews.author: Nina O.
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.content: Lovely villa; road noise at night.

listings.title: Louvre Skip-the-Line Tour
listings.excerpt: Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo and the museum's hidden gems without the queue.
listings.description: Reserved entry and an art-historian guide who takes you straight to the masterpieces.

reviews.author: Sophie V.
reviews.title: Saved hours
reviews.content: We walked straight past the line.

reviews.author: Jack M.
reviews.title: Good guide
reviews.content: Very informative; two hours flew by.
